titles.native: コワレモノ:璃沙 PLUS THE ANIMATION

description:
The next story from Kowaremono: Risa The Animation. Still in the same problem, Risa feels uncomfortable at home because her parents are always noisy. Therefore, she ran away from home and spent the night in her lonely uncle's house. The story continues between her uncle and Risa having sex every day.

(Source: Nekopoi and Has Been Translated and Edited)
